user.title: Speaker Recognition Tools
user.description: Choose which prompt addition to add, or preview the full integration prompt. Each addition can be added once and selected separately in your conversation agent's LLM APIs.

user.title: Add person
user.description: Choose the Home Assistant user account that Speaker Recognition links to this voice, and configure how the agent addresses and refers to them.

data_description.address_as: Optional. Used when speaking directly to this person; leave blank to use the first name on the account.
data_description.third_person_reference: Optional. Used in tool results and when speaking about this person rather than to them; if blank, the configured address form or first name is used (for example, The father).
data_description.entity_aliases: Optional. Add one line per assigned entity in the format entity_id: alias, another alias. The first alias becomes its preferred name; remaining aliases are alternate names. Calendar tools accept any alias when selecting a calendar.
data_description.entities: Entities that belong to this person, such as their calendars and their phone from the Companion App. The agent uses them for requests like "What's on my calendar?" or "What is Sarah doing on Friday?".
data_description.private_entities: Entities from the list above that only this person may use. Anyone else is refused by the calendar and location tools, and the agent is not told about them.

error.already_configured: That account has already been added.
error.private_not_assigned: Every private entity must also be in the Entities list.
error.invalid_entity_aliases: Each alias line must use entity_id: alias, and the entity must be assigned to this person.

base.entity_warnings_acknowledge: Review the entity warnings below and submit again to keep these assignments.

user.title: Add linked device
user.description: Give a device a spoken name, optionally add alternate names, and select the entity that reports its state and the entity used to control it.

data_description.link_name: The agent uses this same name for status questions and action requests.
data_description.link_aliases: Optional. Enter alternate names separated by commas or on separate lines. They use the same status and action entities as the spoken name.
data_description.state_entity: For example, a binary sensor or temperature sensor.
data_description.action_entity: For example, a button or switch entity.
data_description.private: When enabled, only this person can use either linked entity through this integration.

error.link_name_required: Enter a spoken name for this linked device.
error.duplicate_link_name: That spoken name or alias is already used by another linked device for this person.
error.link_entities_must_differ: Choose different entities for status and actions.

data_description.deny_unknown: When on, only the people listed here can interact; everyone else, including requests with no user, is refused.
data_description.refusal_lines: The agent answers a denied speaker with one of these lines.

preview.title: Preview prompt
preview.description: Choose Unknown speaker or a configured person to see the prompt text generated for that speaker.

abort.preview_no_people: Add a person before previewing the prompt.
abort.preview_person_missing: That person is no longer configured.
